_comment: Bones offered by bone_reconstruction_app.py. model_dir is relative to the WP5_reconstruction folder. side: body side of the bones the model was built from (L or R). Landmark codes must match <model_dir>/landmark_indices.txt; the order there is the order the user enters them. view: the bone is shown with the axis up_from -> up_to pointing up and the 'front' landmark facing the viewer. The descriptions are shown to the user and can be edited freely.

ME.name: Medial epicondyle
ME.description: The most prominent bony point on the inner (medial) side of the knee end of the femur, just above the medial condyle.

LE.name: Lateral epicondyle
LE.description: The most prominent bony point on the outer (lateral) side of the knee end of the femur, just above the lateral condyle.

PN.name: Patellar notch
PN.description: The deepest point of the patellar groove (trochlea) on the front of the knee end, between the two condyles, where the kneecap glides.

GT.name: Greater trochanter
GT.description: The top (most proximal) point of the greater trochanter: the large bony prominence on the outer side of the hip end, lateral to the femoral neck.

IN.name: Inner notch
IN.description: The centre of the tibial plateau between the medial and lateral condyles (intercondylar area), at the top of the tibia.

MC.name: Medial condyle
MC.description: The most medial (inner) point of the medial tibial condyle, just below the rim of the plateau.

LC.name: Lateral condyle
LC.description: The most lateral (outer) point of the lateral tibial condyle, just below the rim of the plateau.

TT.name: Tibial tuberosity
TT.description: The most prominent point of the tibial tuberosity: the bump on the front of the tibia, about 4-5 cm below the plateau, where the patellar tendon attaches.

MM.name: Medial malleolus
MM.description: The tip (most distal point) of the medial malleolus: the bony prominence on the inner side of the ankle.
